scenes.title: Three Hours Early
scenes.summary: At twelve noon on Saturday, Klara answers a telephone call from the station announcing that the retired mapmaker arrives at three in the afternoon instead of six.

scenes.title: Four Cakes by Half Past Two
scenes.summary: Klara bursts into the café kitchen with the early-train news, and Miriam and Moritz launch a high-speed relay to bake and cool four berry-and-almond cakes before three.

scenes.title: Keys Two and Six Swapped
scenes.summary: At the front desk, Werner proves from his paper ledger that Martin accidentally handed Room 2's key to Room 6 and Room 6's key to Room 2 while wearing his glasses on his forehead.

scenes.title: Backpacks and a Hatbox
scenes.summary: In the upstairs hallway, Helga steps out of Room 4 to help Klara and Werner guide the swapped hallway bags to their proper doors with cheerful welcome cards.

scenes.title: Four Hands at One Piano
scenes.summary: Inside Room 9, Helga coaches Lukas through their joyful four-hand piano duet, helping the careful architect trade strict counting for warm musical flow.

scenes.title: Cooling Tins in the Shade
scenes.summary: At two-fifteen under the courtyard shade tree, Miriam, Moritz, and Klara cool the four golden cakes in the breeze and brush on the warm honey-orange glaze.

scenes.title: Off to the Station Platform
scenes.summary: At half past two by the street gate, Klara hands Lukas and Moritz a compass-rose welcome card so the two brothers can greet the retired mapmaker at Central Station.

scenes.title: Footsteps Outside the Gate
scenes.summary: At three sharp in the glowing courtyard, Martin checks his glasses on his nose, Miriam sets hot mint tea on table one, and the gate bell rings twice as a taxi arrives.
